evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep never frames the call as 10–15 minutes with a dependable quote and never gets a yes before diving into probing. Jumps immediately to rates: 'For sure, so we just have different hour rates for days...'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Never asked. Rep goes straight into logistics and rate questions without establishing Donald's concerns or what he wants answered on the call.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Rep gives hourly rate ($222/hour for weekend, $204 for Monday) and minimum ($555 for 2.5 hours), but never anchors to a typical range for a storage-unit move or personalizes to Donald's stated time pressure and parking logistics.
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Rep discloses no transport fee ('There wouldn't be any additional fees. It's just the hourly rate') and mentions the 2.5-hour minimum ($555), but never frames the 'not a guess' or 15-minute-increment commitment.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Never asked whether the estimate feels fair. Rep moves straight to booking.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Rep asks only 'Anything else I can help you with?' which is a throwaway. Donald actually raises a substantive concern ('I need someone at least on the crew between one of the two of them that I really understand English') and rep acknowledges it ('Of course, definitely') but does not probe deeper or confirm it's truly resolved.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Never asked 'Would you like our help with your move?' The booking is assumed and driven by Donald's urgency, not a real close by the rep.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Rep confirms: name (Donald Fuller), email, phone, move date (Monday 8:30–9 a.m.), from address (2627 Live Oak Street, 75204), to address (100 Margaret Avenue, 75207), and parking notes. Missing: arrival window confirmed verbally (rep states 8:30–9 but doesn't confirm Donald heard it), crew size never stated, no summary of Donald's concern about English-speaking crew lead to the notes.

top_strength: Jules quickly gathers critical logistics details (addresses, zip codes, floor levels, special parking instructions, storage unit numbers) and adapts the estimate to Donald's specific timeline urgency and constraints.
coaching_note: Section 2 is completely skipped—never ask 'Other than price, what are your biggest concerns about this move?' and listen two layers deep before jumping into rates; this call would have surfaced Donald's real anxieties (deadline, crew communication) much earlier and allowed you to frame the whole pitch around solving them.
